refund_policy: Challenge entry fee refunded in full upon the first successful profit withdrawal
payout_methods: USDT credited to CoinW asset account
max_risk_per_trade: Evaluation: max margin per position 15,000 USDT (BTC/ETH) / 5,000 USDT (other pairs), total margin 200,000 USDT; ≥70% margin usage treated as high-risk 'all-in' behaviour
inactivity_rule: Training account suspended after 30 consecutive days without trading; reactivation request within 15 days or account may be closed
notes: No reset product published. Per-request withdrawal caps: 2-step 250/500/1,000/5,000/10,000 USDT (1K–100K), 1-step 1,000–10,000 USDT; total unlimited (1K 2-step lifetime cap 500). KYC: none to buy/trade; K1 (name, DOB, country) before first withdrawal; K2 ≥10,000 USDT cumulative, K3 ≥50,000. Bots/EAs not explicitly banned, but switching between manual and EA/bots between challenge and funded phase is penalised (50% profit deduction), so ea_bots left null. Copy trading banned except between your own verified accounts. Hedging arbitrage / multi-account hedging banned. Purchase methods: USDT (CoinW wallet), Visa/Mastercard/JCB/UnionPay, PayPal (selected regions), LinePay/PromptPay. Free/promotional accounts capped at 1,000 USDT total scholarship.
